scope: Two-pass claim/citation verification of all externally attributed and quantitative manuscript claims; primary-record metadata, exact nearby passages, bibliography coverage, active user-library relevance, BibTeX/AUX consistency, and explicit limitations were checked. Mathematical claims remain bound to the accepted frozen audit rather than being inferred from citations.
citation_audit_method: citation-check-skill two-pass search verification plus serial primary-record BibTeX audit; serial because the user prohibited agents
